message.content: [罪名]故意伤害;故意毁坏财物<eoa>
message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts and determine which crimes are directly supported.

Facts: High (被告人高某甲) attacked Wang (王某乙) with an axe, hitting his head, then smashed his car (a Chery QQ) with the axe, damaging many parts. Damage value 6340 yuan. He later turned himself in. So crimes: Intentional injury (故意伤害) because he struck head with axe. Also property damage: maybe "故意毁坏财物" (故意毁坏财物罪) or "破坏公私财物罪"? Under Chinese criminal law, damaging another's property intentionally is "故意毁坏财物罪". Also possibly "抢劫"? No. He didn't steal. So likely two crimes: 故意伤害罪 and 故意毁坏财物罪. Also maybe "寻衅滋事"? The act was due to dispute, but the main acts are violent assault and property damage. The law: Article 115 of Criminal Law: "故意毁坏公私财物罪". So we list both.

Thus answer: [罪名]故意伤害;故意毁坏财物<eoa>
